rows.en:
(I came to check out a rumor that Michel
works part-time in Deep Akihabara,
though who knows if it's true...)
rows.notes: Male. Deep Akihabara is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en: (This place is...)
(Th-this is a butler cafe, right...?)
rows.notes: Male. shitsuji kissa = butler cafe, as c08162.

rows.en:
Welcome home, young mast...
Gkh!
rows.notes: Male. Michel recognises the customer mid-greeting.

rows.en: Ah!
rows.notes: x8: the player, frd_mcl_006/107 and frd_yui_007, both genders. As c21387.

rows.en:
(Michel really is working part-time
at a butler cafe...)

Phew...
Welcome home, young master.

Hey, Michel.
Why are you working at a butler cafe, of all places......

My deepest apologies, young master...
My name is not Michel.
It is A-L-T-O.
rows.notes: Male. A-ru-to spelled out syllable by syllable.

rows.en:
(Alto...?
He's using Alto's name without asking...)

So then, Alto, why are you working
at a butler cafe part-ti......
rows.notes: Both genders; cut off mid-word as the Japanese (bai...). The player plays along with the alias.

rows.en:
I am loath to part with you, young master,
but it is almost time for your lessons.
rows.notes: Male. okeiko = lessons (piano, tea ceremony...), a rich young master's schedule.

rows.en: Huh?! Lessons?

Come now, we must hurry, or you will be late.
Come, come!
Whoa, don't push so hard!
Just get out of the shop already!

I came all the way here as a customer,
and you're kicking me out? That's mean, Michel...
I mean, Alto.

Anybody who just shows up to poke fun
doesn't count as a customer.
rows.notes: Both genders. hiyakashi = coming to tease/gawk without buying.

rows.en:
(He didn't have to assume I was just poking fun...
Well, I was half in it for the laughs, but...)

Anyway,
why are you working at a butler cafe of all places?

A friend asked me to fill in for a bit.
It's only short-term, but I ended up working here.

Huh~, so that's how it is.
For a fill-in, it sure suits you...

Heh, naturally.
...Whoops, looks like more customers are coming in.
I'd better get back to work.
Sorry for bothering you at work.
rows.notes: Male. Michel answers 'mattaku da' (you sure did).

rows.en:
Well then, good luck at work,
Alto.
You may leave everything to me, young master.
(Hmm, I mean, he IS a butler, but...)

Welcome home, my lady.
What would you care to drink for tea time?
rows.notes: Both genders: Michel greets another (female) customer. 'my lady' as c23154.

rows.en:
(Is it just me, or does he somehow
look more like a host at a host club...?)

(I came to check out a rumor that Michel-kun
works part-time in Deep Akihabara,
though who knows if it's true...)
rows.notes: Female. Deep Akihabara is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en: (Th-this is a butler cafe, isn't it...?)

Welcome home, my la...
Gkh!
rows.notes: Female. ojousa... cut off; 'my lady' as c10097.

rows.en:
(Michel-kun really is working part-time
at a butler cafe...)

Phew...
Welcome home, my lady.

Hey, Michel-kun.
Why are you working at a butler cafe,
of all places......

My deepest apologies, my lady...
My name is not Michel.
It is A-L-T-O.

(Alto...?
He's using Saotome-kun's name without asking...)
rows.notes: Female; the Japanese has Saotome-kun here.

rows.en:
I am loath to part with you, my lady,
but it is almost time for your lessons.

I came all the way here as a customer,
and you're kicking me out? That's so mean,
Michel-kun... I mean, Alto.

Anyway,
why are you working at a butler cafe of all places?

Huh~, so that's how it is.
For a fill-in, it sure suits you.
Sorry for bothering you at work.
You may leave everything to me, my lady.

(Is it just me, or does he somehow
look more like a host at a host club...?)

(Deep Akihabara has all kinds of shops,
so just walking around is fun.)
(Huh? It's Michel.)

Hm? If it isn't \p.
What are you doing in a place like this?

I was bored, so I came to wander around a bit.
What brings you here, Michel?
Oh, your butler cafe job?

Nah, I already quit the butler cafe job.
I was only filling in for a friend for a bit.

Now that you mention it, you did say that...
But you looked good as a butler, Michel.
What a waste.

Well, sure. But if I'd stayed at that place,
the only customers left would be
young ladies coming to see me.
rows.notes: Both genders. ojousama = the cafe's female customers.

rows.en: Yeah, with that host act of yours, no kidding...

A host? How rude.
I was just serving the young ladies
as a butler, you know?
As a butler, huh...

(Am I the only one who thought
it didn't look that way at all?)

(Deep Akihabara has all kinds of shops,
so just walking around is fun.)
(Huh? It's Michel-kun.)

I was bored, so I came to wander around a bit.
What brings you here, Michel-kun?
Oh, your butler cafe job?

Now that you mention it, you did say that...
But you looked so good as a butler,
Michel-kun. What a waste.

(Am I the only one who thought
it didn't look that way at all?)

uncertain: c10064/c10093/c10108/c10119 use Deep Akihabara, provisional in locations.json.
c10092/c10107/c10115/c10116: hosuto = host-club host; spelled out as 'a host at a host club' at first mention, then 'host'.
c10074: cut off mid-word ('part-ti......') to match the Japanese (bai...).
c10072/c10099: A-ru-to spelled out; rendered 'A-L-T-O'. c10100 (female) says Saotome-kun, as the Japanese.
